headline: Armatus January 7
title: Armatus Release Date January 7 | Game Pass Day One | Gaming News
video_script: Armatus is a roguelite third person shooter from Counterplay Games, the studio behind Godfall. It launches on January seventh, twenty twenty seven, on PlayStation 5, Xbox Series, Switch 2 and PC, and it comes to Game Pass. You play the last warrior of an ancient order in the ruins of Paris. Will you play it? Comment below!
description: Armatus (Counterplay Games, publisher Fictions) launches January 7, 2027 on PS5, Xbox Series, Switch 2 and PC, also via Game Pass. Sources: Gematsu, Steam store page.
